The main takeaway from our work is that

the expression of the anti-apoptotic gene, Bcl-2, is associated with the malignant transformation of human glial cells in vivo and that the expression of Bcl-2 can rescue human glioma cells from apoptosis induced by a wide variety of stimuli in vitro.
